label: preparing
what: Baker and Builder explicitly coordinated bread supplies and private payment for a surprise jubilee celebrating the mayor's forty years of service, intended to remain secret until eighteen. Innkeeper probably assisted by arranging the mayor's hall attendance, but knowing involvement in the surprise is not explicit. Freight carried bread, but knowing assistance is not established. Secretary disclosed the preparations to the mayor on day 1 at 06:50; the mayor acknowledged the jubilee at 07:19, so secrecy did not persist.
